items.where: glue-solar: nothing (grep -rn moment glue_solar docs -> 0 hits). Upstream: /Users/nabil/Git/glue-solar/.venv/lib/python3.14/site-packages/irispy/utils/moments.py:33-209 (irispy-lmsal 0.8.1); rest wavelength in irispy/meta.py:194-198
items.evidence: Installed signature: calculate_moments(cube, *, rest_wavelength=None, wings=None, integrated=False, min_intensity=None, saturation_limit=None). rest_wavelength auto-resolves via SGMeta.rest_wavelength = float(self.get(f'TWAVE{self._iwin}')) * u.AA -> nm (meta.py:198; _iwin set in SGMeta.__init__ by matching TDESC, meta.py:459-479). Ran on real test raster iris_l2_20140329_140938_3860258481 window 'Mg II k 2796' (8,109,63, DN_IRIS_NUV, ctype WAVE/HPLT-TAB/HPLN-TAB): returns RasterCollection with 5 2D SpectrogramCubes: intensity [DN_IRIS_NUV], centroid [nm], width [nm], velocity [km/s], velocity_width [km/s]; each (8,109) with 2D WCS (helioprojective lat/lon), extra_coords ['time'] retained (make_spatial_template drops only wavelength-dependent coords), mask (source mask AND non-finite), meta=SGMeta. All 5 fed through glue_solar.sources.loaders.iris._cube_data unchanged -> 2D Data, world axes 'Helioprojective Longitude/Latitude' in arcsec, components [map, 'map mask', 'Time'], pixel_to_world OK. So the plan's 'ingests outputs unchanged' claim holds for single-scan datasets. Runtime 13 ms for 7480 px (no thread needed). CAVEAT for tests: NO window of either irispy test raster contains its TWAVE (all cropped; e.g. Mg II k 2790.51-2792.09 A vs TWAVE 2796.20 A) so any wings= call with the auto rest wavelength raises ValueError 'No wavelength points found within the specified wings'; calculate_moments(cube, rest_wavelength=2791.3*u.AA, wings=0.5*u.AA, min_intensity=50) works. Auto velocity maps on test data are therefore ~-520 km/s nonsense but run fine. wcs_autolink(DataCollection([raster3D, map2D])) -> [] (also [] for map<->SJI and map<->identical map) so the plan's 'linked to the source' requires explicit links (see P2.1-link).
items.blockers: Needs P2.1-prereq (cube handle). None upstream: irispy 0.8.1 already the declared minimum; no new deps.
items.recommendation: Build as one module glue_solar/sources/moments.py (~100-150 lines + ~40-line test): register with glue_qt.config.layer_action('IRIS: line moments…', single=True, data=True) (right-click on the dataset; callback(layer, data_collection)) instead of a menubar entry plus dataset picker; QFormLayout with rest wavelength (A, prefilled from cube.meta.rest_wavelength, editable), wings low/high (A, blank = whole window), min intensity, saturation limit, integrated checkbox. Produce ONE Data per run: d = _cube_data(first_map, f'{label}-moments') then d.add_component(Component(np.asarray(c.data), units=str(c.unit)), name) for all 5 (verified: 8 components incl. mask and Time), append to the data collection, add two pixel LinkSame links to the source, open an ImageViewer on 'velocity'. Test with an explicit in-window rest wavelength.
items.doc_corrections: PLAN 2.1 / AUDIT: 'released in irispy-lmsal 0.8.1' — calculate_moments (and red_blue, density) were added in irispy 0.7.0 (2026-05-07, PRs #124/#125/#126; git tag --contains 3b9a506 -> v0.7.0); RBA API was simplified in 0.8.0 (#144). Harmless because glue-solar pins >=0.8.1, but say 'since 0.7.0'. PLAN 2.1 'add the maps as datasets linked to the source' — glue-core 1.27 wcs_autolink returns [] for every pairing involving these datasets; links must be created explicitly (pixel LinkSame), and 'maps as datasets' should be 'one dataset with five components'. PLAN 2.1 omits that the 4D stack datasets are plain ndcube.NDCube with dict meta and cannot be passed to calculate_moments as-is (see P2.1-stack).

items.title: Loader keeps a handle to the source SpectrogramCube on the Data
items.evidence: _cube_data sets data.coords = _GlueWCS(cube.wcs.low_level_wcs), data.meta = cube.meta (same SGMeta object), components from cube.data/cube.mask; no reference to cube survives (grep for irispy_cube/weakref/source_cube -> none). Costs of keeping it: none — glue Component stores the array by reference (glue/core/component.py:35 self._data = data; verified np.shares_memory(Component(cube.data).data, cube.data) is True), mask array likewise, read_files is called with uncertainty=False. Data has no __slots__ and Data.__setattr__ (glue/core/data.py:1395-1400) only guards 'hub', so data.irispy_cube = cube works (verified). data.meta['irispy_cube'] = cube also works with SGMeta and meta.fits_header still builds, but session save iterates meta values through context.do (glue/core/state.py:1028-1037) — a plain attribute is invisible to serialization and safer. For stacks, _raster_collection_data passes the stacked ndcube.NDCube to _cube_data; the original SpectrogramCubeSequence (which carries SGMeta/rest_wavelength) is dropped.
items.recommendation: One line in _cube_data: data.irispy_cube = cube. In the stack branch of _raster_collection_data add data.irispy_sequence = sequence (or store the sequence instead) so a stack can be re-wrapped with the scan-0 SGMeta. Skip WeakKeyDictionary/registry: the Data already owns the arrays, the cube adds only WCS+meta, both already referenced by the Data.
items.doc_corrections: None; the plan correctly states the handle is missing.

items.title: Maps as components on the same Data vs separate Data, and how to link
items.where: glue-core 1.27 glue/core/data.py:1040-1110 (add_component shape check), glue/core/link_helpers.py LinkSame, glue/plugins/wcs_autolinking
items.evidence: Same-Data option: src.add_component(2D map) -> ValueError 'The dimensions of component intensity are incompatible ... (8, 109) vs (8, 109, 63)'. Broadcast workaround np.broadcast_to(map[..., None], src.shape) (strides (872, 8, 0), zero memory) DOES work: add_component, ROI subsets, compute_statistic, compute_histogram all fine — but it fakes a wavelength dependence (every slice identical, profile viewer shows a flat line) and pollutes the raster's component list. Separate-Data option: 2 x dc.add_link(LinkSame(src.pixel_component_ids[i], maps.pixel_component_ids[i])) for i in (0,1) — the map shares the raster's spatial pixel grid exactly (make_spatial_template slices at wavelength index 0). Verified: RoiSubsetState drawn on the map (38 px) propagates to the source as 38*63 = 2394 px, and a spatial ROI on the source propagates back to 38 px; a wavelength-axis ROI on the source is IncompatibleAttribute on the map (expected). wcs_autolink gives [] in all pairings, so nothing automatic exists.
items.recommendation: Separate 2D Data (one per moments run, five components) plus two pixel LinkSame links — three lines, exact, and the link chain will carry over to the SJI once raster<->SJI world links exist (Phase 1.4/3.1). Do not use the broadcast-component trick.
items.doc_corrections: PLAN 2.1 should say 'one dataset per run, maps as components, pixel-linked to the source' rather than 'maps as datasets linked to the source' and should not imply autolinking.

items.title: calculate_red_blue_asymmetry wrapper
items.where: Upstream only: irispy/utils/red_blue.py:122-412 (installed 0.8.1 == git checkout, diff -q same)
items.evidence: Signature: calculate_red_blue_asymmetry(cube, *, rest_wavelength=None, velocity_range=(50,150) km/s, dv=10 km/s, continuum_windows=None, degree=3, min_intensity=None, saturation_limit=None, return_profiles=True). rest_wavelength via getattr(cube.meta, 'rest_wavelength', None) (red_blue.py:181) — in installed 0.8.1 a window without TWAVE raises TypeError from float(None) here (moments catches it; RBA does not; the checkout returns None instead). Cube in -> RasterCollection out: 'red_blue_asymmetry' (float, dimensionless, 2D), 'quality' (uint8 flags, 2D), plus with return_profiles=True two 3D cubes 'observed_profile' (8,109,63) and 'interpolated_profile' (8,109,33) with a synthetic VELO FITS WCS (physical types ['spect.dopplerVeloc', None, None]) and plain-dict meta. All four ingest via _cube_data (2D maps get named helioprojective axes; the profile cubes get 'World 1'/'World 2' spatial axes and a velocity axis in m/s). Runtime 41 us/px (0.31 s for 187x40) -> ~18 s for a full 1096x400 raster (pure-Python per-pixel spline loop). On the cropped test data all pixels are flagged 1/6 and no finite RBA values result (rest wavelength outside window), which is fine for a smoke test.
items.blockers: Depends on the P2.1 dialog skeleton and the cube handle. Different form fields from moments (velocity range lo/hi, dv, degree, optional continuum windows), so it is not literally 'one entry in the same action list' but a sibling dialog.
items.recommendation: After P2.1 lands: second layer_action reusing the same form scaffolding; call with return_profiles=False (the profile cubes are the source re-labelled in velocity and a spline resample — no value inside glue) and put asymmetry + quality as two components on one 2D Data with the same two pixel LinkSame links; run in a QThread or accept a busy cursor for large rasters.
items.doc_corrections: PLAN 2.3 'both cube-in/cube-out like calculate_moments' is true for RBA only; note that the default return_profiles=True also yields 3D profile cubes, and that the per-pixel loop is slow (~40 us/px), unlike moments.

items.where: Upstream only: irispy/utils/density.py:99-320 (installed 0.8.1 differs from checkout only in the fiasco import helper); recipe /Users/nabil/Git/irispy/examples/analysis/06_oiv_density_diagnostics.py
items.evidence: Signature: density_diagnostic(intensity_numerator, intensity_denominator, density_grid, *, ion, numerator, denominator, intensity_numerator_uncertainty=None, intensity_denominator_uncertainty=None, temperature=None, bounds_error=False, fill_value=nan, line_ratio_kwargs=None). Inputs are two integrated-intensity ARRAYS/Quantities (not a cube), a density grid, a fiasco.Ion and the two transition wavelengths; it calls fiasco.line_ratio and returns a dict {'ratio', 'ratio_uncertainty', 'density', 'density_lower', 'density_upper', 'density_grid', 'theoretical_ratio', ...} — no WCS, no SpectrogramCube. density.py:148-152 raises ImportError without 'fiasco'; `.venv/bin/python -c 'import fiasco'` -> ModuleNotFoundError; fiasco is not in glue-solar pyproject dependencies (only glue-qt[qt], sunpy[map,net], irispy-lmsal>=0.8.1) and needs the CHIANTI database download on first use. A real use also needs two line intensity maps (O IV 1399.8/1401.2 or 1401.2/1404.8, both inside the 'Si IV 1403' window) i.e. two wings-restricted moments runs first.
items.blockers: New optional dependency (fiasco + CHIANTI data); multi-step workflow (two moments runs on two lines, then ion/grid/temperature choices); output must be re-attached to the source's spatial WCS by glue-solar itself.
items.recommendation: Remove density from the 'near-zero cost, one entry each' framing. Either drop it from the plan or list it under 'on demonstrated demand' with an explicit 'density' extra (fiasco) and a dialog that takes two already-computed intensity components as inputs.
items.doc_corrections: PLAN 2.3: 'density_diagnostic (O IV), both cube-in/cube-out like calculate_moments' is wrong — it is arrays-in/dict-out, requires fiasco (uninstalled, undeclared) and two line-intensity maps; 'one entry each ... at near-zero cost' does not apply to it.

verify.summary: Re-ran every decisive check independently (scripts: scratchpad/verify_moments.py, verify_moments2.py, verify_fork_link.py, verify_fork_link2.py). All six items' status/evidence/feasibility/doc_corrections hold; no refutations. Findings the auditor missed or under-stated: (1) glue-core 1.27 wcs_autolink returns [] for glue-solar datasets because the loader's `_GlueWCS` is a BaseLowLevelWCS and wcs_autolinking.py:320-321 keeps only `isinstance(data.coords, BaseHighLevelWCS)` — glue-solar datasets are filtered out before any WCSLink is attempted; wrapping them in HighLevelWCSWrapper breaks glue (`'HighLevelWCSWrapper' object has no attribute 'world_axis_names'`), so this cannot be fixed in glue-solar alone. On the fork ape14-wcs-autolink (accepts BaseLowLevelWCS at :430) the 2D moment map DOES autolink to the SJI (WCSLink returned), but src3D<->map2D and map2D<->map2D still raise IncompatibleWCS — so the recommended two pixel LinkSame links stay necessary even after Phase 3.1; the plan's 'linked to the source' must be explicit. (2) The auditor's recipe `_cube_data(first_map, ...)` + add_component for all 5 stores the intensity array twice (components 'maps' and 'intensity'); build the Data directly or let `_cube_data` take extra components. (3) The maps' SGMeta is a sliced copy (not the source object) but keeps all keys and `.rest_wavelength`, so a moments Data has its own rest wavelength available. (4) Environment note is stale: ~/.glue/settings.cfg (mtime 08:19) now has `unit_converter = "default"` (the scratchpad settings.cfg.bak shows the earlier "iris-velocity"), and `import glue` works without a HOME override; parent should not act on that warning.
